unconsidered_routes.title: Input log plus checkpoint saves
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Treat a save as seed + scripted command log + a periodic snapshot (every watch). Replaying the log from the last checkpoint must reproduce the state hash. The golden-run test and the bug-repro format become the same artifact, and a corrupt snapshot can be rebuilt from the log.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Factorio / Starcraft replay files; deterministic lockstep
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Adds a command log beside the snapshot in SaveSlotEnvelope; makes S3C-05 the main safety net rather than an extra test.

unconsidered_routes.title: Declared tick schedule instead of a hard-coded frame body
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Define the frame as an ordered list of named phases (commands, watch, materialize, kinematics, cognition, commit, flush), each registered by the engine or by a pack, with the order asserted in one test. Adding advance_watches or materialize becomes inserting a phase, not editing PlaySession and the coordinator.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Bevy / ECS system schedules; Unity Player Loop
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the sequence in PlaySession.frame and the ad-hoc stepFrame + pulse calls (S3C-07).

unconsidered_routes.title: Per-slice versioned save chunks with fixers
unconsidered_routes.proposal: Store each slice (world core, entities, props, acts, observations, legacy) as a named chunk with its own version and a registered upgrade function. A pack that adds a slice adds its chunk and fixer, and old saves load with defaults instead of failing.
unconsidered_routes.reference: Minecraft DataFixerUpper; Dwarf Fortress save versioning
unconsidered_routes.replaces_or_changes: Replaces the single z.literal(1) envelope and the two magic keys __upliftWorldStateSnapshot / __upliftCustomSlicesSnapshot.
